fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 remains a fixed linear lift, so the G13 coefficient-sum-one affine collision is carried to the same affine combination of incidence vectors. A length-31 test cannot establish polynomial trade support, and no explicit design matrix, target, weights, control, or baseline-versus-trade scaling law is frozen.

Proposal 2's exponent-two discriminant quotient is blind to even signed combinations and parity kernels, while gluing does not by itself make incompatible cosets grow faster than the honest radius. The lattice, isotropic subgroup, target, drop coset, scaling rule, and depth recurrence are unspecified, so the proposed shell is not executable or G22-complete.

Proposal 3 cannot restrict unrestricted CVP coefficients to a nonnegative affine semigroup; G13/G19 attacks simply become signed kernel or Graver moves. Toric fiber products can lift bounded moves at every depth, and computing two or three finite Graver bases cannot prove support growth or a G20/G21 relative-gap law.

Proposal 4 requires canonical digit ranges, but linear lattice coordinates permit unrestricted integer digits and carries; anchoring them does not enforce canonical representation without an explicit metric proof and risks reproducing G1. No basis, target, carry equations, weights, completeness radius, control, or valid unrestricted shell bound is frozen.

Proposal 5 supplies no complex or theorem forcing semantic inconsistency into a nontrivial large homology class rather than a small boundary or signed cycle. Cosystolic expansion is not automatically a lower bound for these relative chains, and a support-eight two-clause audit cannot discriminate asymptotic systolic growth or G20/G21.

Proposal 6 again applies fixed linear labels to selectors, so any G13 affine reconstruction remains an affine reconstruction after every embedding; algebraic norm is nonlinear and cannot prevent exact zero or unit cancellations in the emitted linear sum. The finite label search domain, rational factor, normalization pricing, tensor construction, and unrestricted entangled audit are not specified.

Proposal 7 is the only structurally relevant direction but still fails the Generation-25 reopening condition. It does not statically specify the base lattice, ports, finite target representatives, legal/illegal/drop states, glue map, transfer operator, normalization, or recursive closure; consequently B+16 may omit states that later reenter, and no genuinely bounded G22-complete experiment is presently defined.
evidence: G5 found squared-norm-at-most-four circuits in every tested private-row overlap composition, so local certificates do not compose automatically.
G7 produced an exact zero-residual signed selector, while G9/G11 produced constant-cost parity kernels and G12 showed that charging parity exposed a cheaper clause drop.
G13 exhibited a harmful integral affine combination of honest encodings, and G15 lifted it through every tested hierarchy level with zero residual below threshold.
G19 found an exact accepting signed flow with two negative coefficients and zero residual, directly defeating semigroup, flow, and splice intuitions under unrestricted coefficients.
G14 is only a finite B+32 shell pass on one pair-bag instance. No supplied verifier establishes recursive state closure, G20/G21 relative growth, or immunity to G22 entangled vectors.
No proposal supplies new verifier evidence, and none proves a polynomial-size construction with an excess-to-baseline law yielding an n^c gap.
